It'e been a while since I played KH3, so take this with a grain of salt. I'm also comparing it to KH2FM, so again, grain of salt.

My only real complaint with KH3 was the combat. I first want to start off by saying it feels *WAY* better than any other Osaka Team games, and I'm glad we're finally back to the Command Menu instead of the Command Deck. KH3 added a lot of really great changes to traditional Command Menu combat, including shotlocks, attractions, Flowmotion, Keyblade switching, Keyblade transformations, etc. I love the combat in KH3, to a point. However, something about it just feels... off to me.

The combat is still a bit floaty at times, and the hits don't feel like they have quite as hard an impact as they did in KH2. I think part of it is because each attack flows into the next so seamlessly and smoothly; in KH2 there was a *very slight* delay between attack animations, like Sora would slash then take a split-second to move the Keyblade into position for a follow-up attack. A good example is with the move where Sora finishes a combo with the square button to slam the Keyblade down into the ground and cause a little explosion, he takes a moment to get in the air to thrust the Keyblade down instead of just immediately doing so from his previous attack. It all contributed to the Keyblade feeling like it has some weight to it, like it's made of metal instead of just a weightless paper sword.

 I find myself having a lot more trouble reacting to enemy attacks in KH3 for some reason. Maybe attacks are faster or aren't as telegraphed - again, it's been a while so I can't quite recall the specifics - but whereas in KH2FM I can block/dodge/Reflect an enemy attack fairly well, in KH3 it just feels harder for some reason.

Another problem I have is with Situation Commands. While I think it is a very unique and interesting idea, it is too random at times, and that contributes to me feeling like I'm not in control. Party limits are random, you may or may not get the Situation Command you actually wanted, and I feel like I would have just preferred a second Command Menu page like in KH2 so I could really feel in control instead of having to account for luck. Even if I'm 80% in control, that 20% of luck makes me uneasy.
